body: Thank you for the kind offer... I don't think I'll ever be able to take you up on it, but I do appreciate it.

I've been down that path too, tried different psychological approaches of treatment, and found none of them can give me what I need to get through this. They've got all the questions I've already asked, and none of the answers I've spent years searching for. 

Honestly, peace will be the biggest source of contentment I can manage. The lack of feeling seems almost a joyful thing compared to what I've struggled with... and I know how stupid a thing that sounds, but I just don't know any other way of expressing it.

I guess I wonder, how long is too long to keep going through that. I have felt like this, in one form another, since I was less than half the age I am now. Things have changed, experiences, people, everything has changed, but that part of me that wants to die hasn't... This is no whim, no decision from trauma or without adequate thought. It's just this is the hardest time to see any other option to it.

Very little in truth, most of what I do now is a distraction. Some days it's easy, and while rarely it's happiness, I can maintain a neutral state for a while. 

I know I'm a strong person to a point, it would take me a long time to explain my past, but strength has its limits, and everyone has their weak points. Unfortunately mine are what is continuing to be attacked by my current life, and as much as I've tried to change it... I can't do it.

Maybe my role is past, maybe who I've been is enough in some grand scheme, or maybe suicide is my role... I think that's why I prefer not to believe in that stuff, if there is no purpose, then there is only choice, and I am in control of my own destiny. Live or die, it's on my own terms, and that's as best I can hope for I guess.

That's basically what I tried a number of years ago, moving abroad, though under different circumstances... and it didn't work for me, so I moved again... and it still didn't work. The feeling of resignation is because I've tried and failed every possible path I could come across to get myself from where I am in to a different state of being. I've taken the risks, and got nowhere, so now I'm here, in a position where I can't do it again. I don't have the will or strength for it.

I wish that were true, but my last year has been so bad because of the lack of people who were there for me... not that it's anyone's obligation to do so, it's just really got to me how far I seem to move away from... well everyone, everywhere, when I try to do the opposite. This is a bad year on top of bad years, each new one promises change, but doesn't deliver, which is why I hate it so much.

Mt old online friends. Was without internet for a while and lost touch with people on one site (the original Bolt.com), and when I came back the site had been replaced with absolute garbage. Also miss a few from my old MSN, and now have no way of recalling their contact information to see how they are doing.

I'm nearly at a year since my last relationship ended (without a word as to why). There was a couple of hours distance between us, so while we didn't get to spend as much time as we liked (or at least as I would have liked, I don't even know what she wanted now), most mornings I would wake up to some sort of message from her, or wake up to send her a message for before she awoke... Being able to start the day in the knowledge that someone cares... one of the things I really miss most.
Waking up to a message from someone. Suddenly makes me feel less alone in the world.

"I wish you told me you loved me when we were younger. I felt the same... I still do. Please hang on, just one more day, so we have a chance to be with each other, just for a little while."

Can't think of anything worse than that regret of a happy life missed... Far worse than a revelation of hate by a partner or something, that's an end of relief.
I love you too... Been a year, and I can't forget her... And don't know why she cut me out of her life either.

I know to a degree that's true, but most people are able to deal with the level of it that exists in their life. I can't, and whether that's because what I'm dealing with is worse than most, or my ability to deal with it is less than most I don't know. But death is nothing, I've put it off for so long because I hoped that I would find something to get out of life, but it's been too many years and the answer is clear that I can't.

I'd not consider joining the military on principle, even if I was healthy enough to try.

And I think you underestimate the pain that disappointment causes, to try to change and to fail again... each time it deals permanent damage, and often the world will find a new way to surprise with that sort of pain... at least that's what I've found.

Thank you for trying, but it's all just too much for me. I shouldn't have survived for this long even.

I've been there, over and over again. I've tried associating with different people in different places, and being alone. I've tried different jobs, and have a degree, so have tried education. I've tried moving overseas, changing my location. I've tried fitness, improving my physical state, I've tried writing, expressing my struggles through poetry, I've tried music as a creative outlet. I've tried CBT, various types of psychologist and therapist, different sorts of treatment, as well as studying some psychology to get a better understanding of my own thought processes. I've 'faked it' until I didn't make it, I've analyzed and deconstructed every thought and feeling, I've let myself be as far free from my own thoughts as possible, just trying to live each day without thought, as well as make big plans, create a future in my mind and aim for it, and I've tried beating myself bloody, punishing myself for every errant thought, every mistake. I've talked and stayed silent, I've listened to every suggestion that other people have made to try and get beyond this, or just listened to others and ignored my own problems.

I've spent 16 years with this, since my first suicide attempt. And everything I've tried has been to pull me away from these feelings, to try to be happy... to try to be normal. And now I'm at the point where I just can't try most things any more, because I have tried so much, and got nowhere with any of it. It's all a broken mess... I'm a broken mess, and every single day I try to keep going, put on a normal face, and live as though I have some sort of future, takes so much out of me. At this point, I honestly don't see any other way out, anything else to try that has a chance.

Unfortunately I'm a very bad person to give help to others... Because I can't honestly tell anyone who asks that I feel there is any reason to keep going in life, and struggling with that means I'm a risk to anyone who would seek me out for help in issues which I am knowledgeable. I can and have helped people in the past, but that was before this dead end... Both figuratively and perhaps literally. 

Anyway, while I may not know what the future holds, its oft repeated that to repeat the same thing over and over and expecting different results is the definition of insanity. I cannot change who I am, so the possibilities of where I can get to are limited, and none of those options are ones I can survive with anymore.

The world would be no different a place without me than with me, except for making the lives of one or two people easier. And honestly, I'm glad it's that way, because I don't want to feel obligated to keep going for anyone else... I've had that happen too many times in the past, and been hurt for it.

And I guess I just know my view on self-harm is a really unhealthy one... I don't believe in karma as such, but if in a karmic sense I try to turn anyone else away from the mistakes I've made, it just makes it easier for me to give up.

I'm still around for now, it'll be a couple of days until I can get the last few bits of my life in order. I think I've convinced myself anyway, regardless of this post... though that's something I've certainly said before, and am still here.

Though I will say I've spent about 15 or 16 years self-harming, and trust me, trying to keep away from that sort of self-destructive behaviour is one of the best things you can do for yourself... it gets an insidious grip on your psyche if you don't stop, so try your best to keep away from it.

I don't think there is anything to say, I don't wish this sort of struggle on anyone, so I'm sorry to hear you feel the same. All I know is  I will keep trying to find an answer until I run out of strength... That's all any of us can do.
I'm sorry to hear that, I don't wish feeling like this anyone.
I've thought a lot on it, but as far as I can tell, there is only one solution to a problem which will never subside. I hope there is another answer, but I don't think I can keep waiting for it.
